name: GIT Auto Commit Push
headline: git-auto-commit-push: Claude Code skill for Version
short_description: This skill streamlines the process of committing and pushing changes to Git repositories. It is designed for developers looking to automate their version control workflows.
author: giikin

sections.overview:
git-auto-commit-push is a Git version control skill that automates the process of committing and pushing changes to repositories. Designed for developers who want to streamline their workflow, it reduces manual steps in the commit-and-push cycle. This skill is particularly useful for teams and individuals looking to improve efficiency in their version control practices.
Automate daily Git commits for ongoing projects
Set up a schedule to push changes to a remote repository
Reduce manual intervention in version control processes
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy

`git clone https://github.com/giikin/skills`
